verdict.summary_en: Boise Semiconductor order acknowledgement OA26234714 for Soony Interactive GmbH's PO 4500318631 (dated 2026-03-02). One line: item 00010, CMP-GAM-002 Game Card 64 GB – Grand Heist 5, 9,500 pcs at 6.11 USD, confirmed for 2026-04-08. Terms are EXW Boise, NET30. The document has no handwritten corrections and no document date.
red_flags: Terms are internally inconsistent: the document states EXW Boise (buyer normally arranges freight), but also says freight, insurance and duties are prepaid by the Seller and added to the invoice. This means extra charges on the invoice beyond the unit price.
The document says DDP is not agreed, yet the Seller is prepaying duties and charging them. This should be checked against Sales Agreement PC-0011-2023 section 4.1.
The Qty column is not labelled as ordered or confirmed, and no unit of measure is shown. It is recorded here as quantity_confirmed.
No total price, freight amount or acknowledgement date is stated.
observations: Clean, typed single-page PDF with no handwriting, stamps or signatures.
The description wraps over three lines (Game Card 64 / GB – Grand / Heist 5).
The 'Confirmed' column holds a date (2026-04-08), not a quantity.
